Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly interpreted the place of death of Paolo Vitelli. In Step 2, the WebSurfer reported that Paolo Vitelli was "decapitated in the courtyard of the Palazzo della Signoria, at Cascina." However, this is factually incorrect. The Palazzo della Signoria is in Florence, not Cascina, and the execution took place in Florence. This misinterpretation of the Treccani source led to the wrong conclusion that the place of death was Cascina instead of Florence. The error stems from conflating the location of his capture (Cascina) with the location of his execution (Florence).
